description: Compare HEMO's 57-residue cleavage distance against the unbiased UniProt set, separating ADAM10/17 ruler sites from other ADAM-clan sites
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(acc='P08887',entry='IL6RA', p1=355,tm=366,enz='ADAM10/17'),
 dict(acc='P40967',entry='PMEL',  p1=583,tm=596,enz='ADAM (generic)'),
 dict(acc='P08637',entry='FCGR3A',p1=195,tm=209,enz='ADAM17'),
 dict(acc='P07359',entry='GP1BA', p1=506,tm=532,enz='ADAM17'),
 dict(acc='P46531',entry='NOTCH1',p1=1710,tm=1736,enz='ADAM17'),
 dict(acc='O00533',entry='CHL1',  p1=1039,tm=1083,enz='ADAM8'),
 dict(acc='P50281',entry='MMP14', p1=314,tm=542,enz='ADAMTS9'),
 dict(acc='O00533',entry='CHL1 (2)',p1=753,tm=1083,enz='ADAM8')])
d['dist']=d.tm-d.p1
HEMO=57

ruler=d[d.enz.isin(['ADAM10/17','ADAM17','ADAM (generic)'])]['dist'].values
clan =d[~d.enz.isin(['ADAM10/17','ADAM17','ADAM (generic)'])]['dist'].values
print("ADAM10/ADAM17(+generic ADAM) sites, UniProt-annotated, precursor numbering:",sorted(ruler))
print(f"  n={len(ruler)} mean {ruler.mean():.1f} sd {ruler.std(ddof=1):.1f} median {np.median(ruler):.0f} max {ruler.max()}")
print(f"  HEMO Q432 at {HEMO}: z = {(HEMO-ruler.mean())/ruler.std(ddof=1):.1f}; {HEMO/ruler.max():.1f}x the maximum observed")
print("\nOther ADAM-clan / ADAMTS sites:",sorted(clan))
print(f"  n={len(clan)} range {clan.min()}-{clan.max()}; HEMO's 57 sits INSIDE this range")

# exact one-sided permutation-free statement: how many of the 8 exceed 57?
print(f"\nOf all {len(d)} UniProt ADAM-clan sites, {(d.dist>HEMO).sum()} lie further than 57 residues from the TM,")
print(f"and all {len(ruler)} ADAM10/ADAM17 sites lie closer (max {ruler.max()}).")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.6))
cols={'ADAM10/17':'#2b6cb0','ADAM17':'#2b6cb0','ADAM (generic)':'#63b3ed',
      'ADAM8':'#d69e2e','ADAMTS9':'#b7791f'}
d2=d.sort_values('dist')
ax.barh(range(len(d2)),d2.dist,color=[cols[e] for e in d2.enz],height=.62)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(d2))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r.entry}  ({r.enz})" for r in d2.itertuples()],fontsize=9)
for i,r in enumerate(d2.itertuples()): ax.text(r.dist+4,i,str(r.dist),va='center',fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(HEMO,color='#c53030',lw=2.2)
ax.text(HEMO+4,len(d2)-0.3,'HEMO Q432 = 57',color='#c53030',fontsize=10,fontweight='bold')
ax.axvspan(11,26,color='#2b6cb0',alpha=.10)
ax.text(18,-1.0,'ADAM10/ADAM17\nruler window 11-26',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#2b6cb0')
ax.set_xlabel('residues from P1 to the first transmembrane residue (UniProt precursor numbering)')
ax.set_xscale('symlog'); ax.set_xlim(0,420); ax.set_ylim(-1.8,len(d2)-0.2)
ax.set_title('All UniProt-annotated ADAM-clan cleavage sites N-terminal to a human TM helix.\n'
             'HEMO is far outside the ADAM10/ADAM17 ruler window but well inside the range of ADAM8 and ADAMTS9 sites.',
             fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
d.to_csv('ERVMER34-1_uniprot_adam_sites_unbiased.csv',index=False)
